notes: Version 2.60 records the ENI-colour correction in ENI 2.9, the Non-Injective Foundations Note 1.8, Foundation 2.7.1 and KUD 1.6. ENI's Section 6 states the sum-zero arithmetic of conjugate pairs and triples without identifying it with colour, leptons, quarks or a spin-1/2 module, and its tower is a template whose premises are open. The colour implication runs in the direction the theorem supports: a projection onto colour-neutral observables is non-injective under the premises of ENI Corollary 6; colour neutrality is the premise, so the non-observability of free colour is not derived. No colour stratum is supplied by the programme. The ENI entry also cites ENI's main theorem as Theorem 3 and its colour material as Section 6. Both NIF-Note version lines read 1.8.
